resources.string: Lets you watch one Instagram Reel or YouTube Short at a time, sends you back when you swipe to the next one, hides the Reels and Shorts tabs, the Explore grid and feed posts from accounts you don\'t follow. It only acts on Instagram and YouTube and sends nothing anywhere.
Explore is hidden.\nTap the search bar to find people.
Hidden: not from someone you follow
Watch the Reel your friend sent. Skip the endless scrolling.

To turn it on: Accessibility → Installed apps (or Downloaded apps) → Eliminate Fluff blocker → On.\n\nIf the switch is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\"), go to Settings → Apps → Eliminate Fluff → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
